changes.key: 可以直接拿打工時數抵實習嗎？
changes.old: Can part-time work hours be directly used to waive the internship?
changes.new: Can my part-time work hours count toward the internship requirement?
changes.reason: 抵實習是認列時數，不等於waive整個義務。
changes.canonical_chinese: 可以直接拿打工時數抵實習嗎？

changes.key: 不一定。請先把公司、職務與工作內容交系辦或實習指導老師確認，取得認列回覆後再安排。
changes.old: Not necessarily. Please submit the company, position, and job duties to the department office or internship faculty advisor for confirmation, and make arrangements only after receiving credit recognition approval.
changes.new: Not necessarily. First ask the department office or your internship faculty advisor to review the company, position, and job duties. Wait for confirmation of whether the work can be recognized before making arrangements.
changes.reason: 把認列回覆譯清楚，不先宣稱已核准學分。

changes.key: 組員人數、退組或補審要看哪裡？

changes.key: 請向系辦索取當屆正式辦法，確認組隊、異動與補審；不要套用他系或往年規則。

changes.reason: 追審査改原詞加說明；保留當屆、異動與不可套他系舊規。
changes.canonical_chinese: 請向系辦索取當屆正式辦法，確認組隊、異動與補審；不要套用他系或往年規則。
